message: My friend Karren Alenier would be interesting, but she's local to DC, not NY, though her arm could be twisted gently, methinks.  She is a local poet who wrote a libretto to an opera on Gertrude Stein--it was produced in New York, now that I think about it.  Anyhow, go to my blog and look at the entries on the left column--you'll find her blogs there.
